explication: This Terraform module deploys an Azure Key Vault and related access, networking, and monitoring resources, with reusable key and secret submodules. The documented workflow is for a caller to configure the root module, which manages the vault and supporting resources and passes location and telemetry settings to the child modules. Source excerpts were not provided, so the graph uses README-documented capabilities and relationships only; implementation-level links are omitted where the documentation does not establish them.
